AnchorIdentity.description: R4 string binding values. Legacy word/beat indices are meaningful only against verified immutable source reads; not stable identities across republication. Exact source-word provenance is captured in reads/dependencies.

row.description: Complete literal parent clip row, preserved exactly, including unknown JSON. Preallocated ID; existing active output track. at and hold are seconds without creation-time rounding. Media, source windows and following anchors are unsupported in v1.

on.description: Absolute timeline seconds. Fixed start, keep authored duration, non-ripple; quantize once using pinned rational fps.

ClipSetArgs.description: Bounded raw clip fields. Set hold in source seconds; explicitly remove hold, asset or incoming transition. Clear removes presence, never sets null/empty. Asset assignment requires the scoped clip.swap-media or occurrence.swap-media; transition authoring is outside v1.

hold.description: Positive finite source seconds; timeline duration is hold/speed.

ClipSetElementArgs.description: Replace an existing clip elementRef with another revision of the same element id, kind and selected pack owner. Admitted revisions require the exact retained schema_source declaration pin. The retired element_ref alias is removed. There is no clear: a clip keeps its element.

ClipSetParamsArgs.description: Patch raw clip.params by literal top-level JSON keys in stored units, never dotted paths or expressions. Null is a value; clear removes presence. Set/clear overlap is refused by the handler. Preserve unmentioned keys.

on.description: Absolute timeline seconds strictly inside the clip. Preserve half-open frame geometry and literal film end.

right_id.description: Caller-allocated right clip ID, retained on replay and redo.

ClipTrimArgs.description: Source seconds on literal parent media. Omitted/null endpoints retain existing from/to, defaulting to zero/file duration. Keep at and asset; write from/to/hold using main trim precedence and clear for/until. Requires authored registry duration; no media fetch.

CommandBatch.description: Runtime CommitRequest.commands references this array. Restore must be the sole command; nested restore is also forbidden by provider semantic validation.

DocumentPin.description: Exact original admitted project-pack Document pin for selected parameter validation.

select.description: parent asserts a flat assembly target; a parent clip reference asserts that populated replacement target. Both require the complete ordered parent clip inventory.
parent appends; a stable parent clip reference inserts immediately after that clip. Birth never deletes the selected boundary.

EditCommand.description: Client recorder fields are claims only. Provider verifies/reconstructs all observations; authorship is write classification, never authenticated actor identity. Unknown operations pass the envelope only and require installed registered schemas/handlers.

args.description: The registered operation schema closes its own keys. Unknown extension values are opaque finite JSON; no global clear sentinel.

version.description: Pinned operation implementation version as a string; never a tool release version or null.

ElementRef.description: The clip elementRef field, exactly as stored: draft refs carry no packId, admitted pack refs do.

steps.description: When present, select nonempty unique step IDs for every target publication; omitted selects the whole target commits.

JSON.description: Only finite JSON enters validation; transport rejects duplicate keys and non-finite numeric tokens before schema validation.

MediaSelection.description: Exact five-field selection from Runtime ABI 1 selected_media; metadata is supplied by the scoped provider port, never command arguments.

consumed.description: Raw IDs of existing occurrence clips whose rows an automatic builder read to choose the start or lane; each row is recorded as a guard.

on.description: Absolute start in seconds; quantized to parent frames.

consumed.description: Raw IDs of existing occurrence clips whose rows an automatic builder read to choose the start or lane; each row is recorded as a guard.

hold.description: Literal occurrence-local image duration in seconds.

id.description: Caller-reserved raw child clip ID; an occupied ID refuses.

on.description: Absolute timeline seconds; quantized once with pinned rational fps, then made occurrence-local.

PropertyPath.description: R4 token path; empty is the whole entity. Parse JSON bracket atoms before overlap comparison. No entity array-position selectors.

action.description: add appends the media alias to the shot pool and binds it; remove drops the alias and keeps the binding.

ShotSetArgs.description: Occurrence-owned raw shot payload fields: canonical root name and bounded scalar settings roots. Null is a value; clear removes presence. Unmentioned fields survive. Compound settings roots (steerableMotionSettings, phaseConfig, pairConfigs, shotImageIds, loras, structureVideo, modelSettingsByModel) are unsupported.

anyOf.description: R4 id::path or bare path (including empty); bare form requires exactly one resolved target. Provider parses and checks identity/path ambiguity, including :: inside a quoted property token.
R4 id::path or bare path (including empty); bare form requires exactly one resolved target. Provider parses and checks identity/path ambiguity, including :: inside a quoted property token.
R4 id::path or bare path (including empty); bare form requires exactly one resolved target. Provider parses and checks identity/path ambiguity, including :: inside a quoted property token.

TimelineInitArgs.description: App empty-timeline defaults only. Requires authenticated original bootstrap publication; never a root replacement or repair.

TokenPath.description: Normalized property tokens, not entity collection positions. Empty array means the whole entity. Numeric array tokens use canonical decimal strings; provider validates pinned parent-container types before traversal.

TrackSetArgs.description: Set raw track.label or explicitly remove it. Null is not a label. Unmentioned fields survive.

https://astrid.haus/workspace/v1/schemas.description: M0 canonical command schema, schema_version 1. Agent semantic source; Runtime byte-identical pinned projection. Slim provider ABI 1 is a separate Runtime contract. This artifact does not define Runtime request/closure/port/record envelopes.
https://astrid.haus/workspace/v1/schemas.title: EditCommand

payload.description: Exact main immutable internal payload, including authored and opaque siblings.

clips.description: Raw authored ordinary clips; Agent owns command, timing and reference validation.

config.description: Exact authored parent config; partial output and opaque fields are preserved.

registry.description: Runtime-managed media registry carried by the publication envelope; Runtime-specific and outside the canonical TimelineConfig owned by @banodoco/timeline-schema.

RawOutput.description: Authored output may be partial. Frame rate representations are preserved; Agent owns their timing semantics.

RawTimelinePayload.description: Main immutable authoring payload, not a compiled Player configuration. Known containers are typed; missing fields, explicit opaque nulls and unknown siblings are preserved. Agent validates and compiles command/document/timing/reference semantics.

ShotPayload.description: Open shot payload. Only the cross-consumer core is typed; all unknown sibling and nested extension fields remain lossless.

audio.description: Optional legacy aggregate audio descriptor. Read when present, preserve as authored, and never require, fabricate, or collapse it from child audio clips/bindings.

audio_bindings.description: Actual child audio bindings; authoritative with child audio clips for playback. Optional and never derived from the legacy aggregate audio descriptor.

internal_timeline_revision_id.description: Immutable link to the child timeline revision.

name.description: Canonical name for new writes. Reads may fall back through provenance/metadata name/title aliases and then stable shot identity.

timing.description: Open timing metadata. Visible-duration semantics remain at the canonical timeline/consumer boundary.

https://astrid.haus/workspace/v1/schemas.description: Runtime-owned immutable publication envelope. Raw immutable containers preserve authored and opaque data. Compiled TimelineConfig semantics remain owned by @banodoco/timeline-schema.
https://astrid.haus/workspace/v1/schemas.title: Canonical one-level shot composition publication
https://astrid.haus/workspace/v1/schemas.x-astrid-runtime-generated-boundary: Use the pinned TimelineConfig only for compiled data; raw containers reuse compatible common fields without requiring Player completeness.

Meta.description: Optional bounded namespace map. Canonical byte and depth limits are provider-enforced.

MetaNamespaceKey.description: ASCII namespace key for opaque extension metadata.

MetaNamespaceValue.description: Opaque namespace payload; the namespace root is always an object.

MetaValue.description: A finite JSON descendant of an opaque metadata namespace.

meta.description: Runtime-owned opaque extension metadata; ignored by TimelineConfig consumers.
